outline_shape.value: six soft cloud lobes like reference image 2: shallow round bumps around a near-circular body

layout.value: square colour screen centred above three round buttons, lanyard nub on top, as reference image 1

display.value: seeed/grove-1-2inch-ips-display (1.2 in 240x240 IPS, ST7789, 40x40 mm board)

buttons.value: 3 tactile switches 6x6 mm with printed domed caps; centre one larger

charging.value: USB-C on the XIAO, reachable through the shell side

design_direction.value: soft six-lobed cloud pebble in translucent lavender-blue, dark round bezel around the square screen, three domed paw-pad buttons on the three lower lobes, small lanyard ball on top

custom_pcb.value: Custom PCB requested for pet device

key_pcb_implementation.value: Shaped three-key carrier PCB, 59x26.5 mm envelope, right-angle Grove display socket, XIAO D0/D1/D3 keys and D9/D10 display; two-layer FR4, manual through-hole assembly; solder wire pigtails to DNP header footprints.

display_grove_on_pcb.value: Integrate the display Grove connector onto pet-keys PCB

charging_opening_appearance.value: Approved recessed rounded USB-C opening with same-colour inner surround; preserve opening and XIAO location during PCB adaptation.

button_group_spacing.value: Bring the three front buttons closer together.
